since.description:

doesn't start sessions for the backlog. Slack connectors move it forward on every check.

team.description: The Linear team a Slack connector's sessions file issues in, by name or key.

worktree.description: Runs each session in its own git worktree, so parallel issues don't share a checkout.

oneOf.description: Analyze and reply; never file an issue or change code.

replied.description: Someone mentioned the bot in the thread after its session started, which `Fix::Ask` waits for.

seen.description: The newest message pinned read, when people wrote past `cursor` without mentioning the bot.
